scenario: [LSMP.3.2a]: the compiler rejects `bool_and` / `bool_or` under `sample` with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_AGG_TIME_MODEL_MISMATCH -- an exact predicate, which a uniform sample can answer wrongly by omitting the one value that decides it ([LSMP.3.2]). `bool_and` is pinned by `compiler/LSER.sample_bool_reject`; this is the `bool_or` half, which nothing pinned. Pin: `bool_or sample 200` on a Bool slot is refused with that code.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    active: Bool mutable

series Sensor.active:
    bool_or sample 200
